facts.business: Srestha Finvest Limited is a Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India as an Investment and Credit Company (NBFC-ICC) and classified as NBFC-Base Layer, engaged in finance, loans, investment, consultancy, and dealing in securities activities.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Non-provision of interest of Rs.68.25 Lakhs on borrowings/ICD from Arcadia Shipping Ltd, resulting in understatement of finance cost and loss after tax for the quarter and year ended 31.03.2026.

key_risks: Dynamic industry risks inherent in financial sector
Non-provision of interest on borrowings from Arcadia Shipping Ltd leading to legal disputes
Compliance with applicable Indian Accounting Standards, RBI Guidelines and other statutory requirements
Completeness in identification, accounting and disclosure of related party transactions
